run_grammar_constrained_generation: run a script that generates valid JSON arrays using grammar-constrained text generation with Mistral-7B
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar file to constrain model output to valid JSON
build_grammar_logits_processor: build a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor that enforces EBNF grammar rules during token generation
generate_json_with_transformers: generate grammar-constrained JSON output from a causal language model using logits processors
decode_batched_token_ids: decode batched token IDs back to text strings using the tokenizer batch_decode method
